question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**luxury**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given blank refers to something considered non-essential but desirable if one has the means.
 
• The term '**luxury**' refers to a state of great comfort or elegance, especially when involving great expense. It indicates something indulgent or enjoyable beyond the basic necessities. (विलासिता)
 
 
• **Example**: Owning a private yacht is a **luxury **few can afford.
 
 
 
• 'Luxury', in this context, signifies something that is not essential but highly desirable, fitting the description required to complete the sentence appropriately. (विलासिता)
 
• Hence, the correct choice is **luxury**.

Therefore, the correct answer is “**Option 3**”.

Complete Passage: *Children are the future of any country and a country that does not take care of this valuable__ resource suffers later. A successful nation is that which makes its youth strong enough to lift this **__mighty__ responsibility on their shoulders. **__Unfortunately__, this is not the case in our country. Education, which is a necessity, is still a **__luxury__** here. Poor people (5) ________ to send their children to school.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Theory **refers to a system of ideas intended to explain something, especially one based on general principles independent of the thing to be explained. (सिद्धांत)

 
 
• **Example**: The **theory **of evolution by natural selection is a pivotal concept in biology.
 
 
 
• **Delight **means great pleasure. It is used to describe something that brings a high degree of satisfaction or joy. (प्रसन्नता)
 
 
• **Example**: The child's performance brought **delight **to all the spectators.
 
 
 
• **Study **refers to the devotion of time and attention to acquiring knowledge on an academic subject, especially by means of books. (अध्ययन)
 
 
• **Example**: Her **study **of the language has made her fluent.
